select pf.*, p.name as product_name, p.product_no, p.cover_image, p.price, p.selling_point, c.name as category_name, b.name as brand_name from product_favorite pf left join product p on pf.product_id = p.id left join product_category c on p.category_id = c.id left join product_brand b on p.brand_id = b.id
and pf.user_id = #{userId} and pf.product_id = #{productId} and p.name like concat('%', #{productName}, '%')
order by pf.id desc
